name: Sheraton Suites Calgary Eau Claire
description: One of Calgary's finest and most conveniently located all-suite hotels — the Sheraton Suites Calgary Eau Claire is a prestigious 4-star all-suite hotel in the heart of downtown Calgary, 20 minutes from Calaway Park, offering elegant suites, an outstanding pool and fitness centre, and easy access to Calgary's best restaurants and attractions.

A popular choice for Calaway Park visitors wanting a premium downtown Calgary experience.

name: Holiday Inn Calgary Airport
description: A comfortable and family-friendly Holiday Inn just 15 minutes from Calaway Park — the Holiday Inn Calgary Airport offers spacious rooms, an indoor pool, complimentary breakfast and easy access to both Calgary Airport and Calaway Park. The most convenient hotel for Calaway Park visitors arriving by air.
